Bring daily heat therapy home with the Maxxus MX-S306-01 ELITE, a 3-person ultra low EMF FAR infrared sauna crafted from natural reforested Canadian Hemlock. Designed for consistent, full-body comfort, it uses 8 FAR infrared carbon heating panels and a calming cabin layout that supports relaxation, recovery, and a more intentional wellness routine.

The MX-S306-01 ELITE is built around an easy, practical experience—starting with its clasp-together assembly and a spacious interior sized for solo stretching or sharing a session with family. The sauna is engineered for a comfortable operating window, with an ideal temperature range of 118°F–132°F and the ability to heat up to 140°F. Inside, the atmosphere is elevated with an interior chromotherapy lighting system featuring a Red Light mode, plus an interior LED control panel so you can manage your session without stepping out. For entertainment and ambience, the sauna includes Bluetooth and an MP3 auxiliary connection with built-in speakers, helping you set the tone—whether that’s quiet breathwork, a guided session, or music while you unwind.

On the exterior, the sauna’s clean, modern lines pair with a bronze privacy tempered glass door to give the room a finished look while still feeling open and inviting. The Canadian Hemlock construction is selected for indoor sauna environments and creates a warm, natural setting that fits a wide range of home spaces. Electrical planning is straightforward: the unit is specified for 120V / 20 AMP service with a non-GFCI dedicated receptacle and breaker (and it is not a 220/240V unit).

About Maxxus: Maxxus designs indoor infrared saunas that focus on practical assembly, comfort-forward layouts, and feature sets that support consistent at-home use. The MX-S306-01 ELITE is aimed at customers who want a roomier 3-person format paired with an ultra low EMF heating approach and modern session features—without complicating day-to-day operation.
